## Feature

What feature would you like to see added?

## Why would this be useful?

Explain what problem this feature would solve or how it would improve the bot.

## Suggested Implementation

If you have an idea of how this could be implemented, describe it here.

## Alternatives

Are there any alternative solutions or features you considered?

## Additional Information

Add screenshots, examples, links, or anything else that may help.
